provider.name: IUCN Red List of Threatened Species
provider.organization_type: global extinction-risk assessment, species-status, taxonomy, geospatial, classification, standard, API, download, and policy infrastructure
provider.description: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species is the global standard for assessing species extinction risk. It provides taxonomic records, scientific and common names, category and criteria assignments, assessment rationales, population data, geographic range, habitat, threats, conservation actions, use and trade, maps, contributors, citations, spatial downloads, summary statistics, standards, training, APIs, and versioned releases.
institutional_context: International Union for Conservation of Nature
IUCN Red List Committee and Standards and Petitions Committee
Red List Authorities, specialist groups, assessors, reviewers, and institutional partners

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting IUCN Red List documentation, categories and criteria, assessment methodology, taxonomy, species accounts, population and range data, habitats, threats, actions, maps, downloads, schemas, APIs, training, governance, publications, citations, licenses, institutional context, and related conservation frameworks.
purpose.authoritative_notice: IUCN, the IUCN Red List, official standards and guidelines, published assessments, official API documentation, download releases, governance bodies, and cited sources remain authoritative for categories, criteria, taxonomy, assessment status, versions, legal conditions, and contacts.
